action_catalog.display_name: Let go of the bound weapon

parameters.description: Bind Weapon: let go of the weapon bound to the enemy's blade (no Action); the bind and its grapple end, and the weapon falls at the binder's feet.
Use your Action to make Jian (Straight Sword) attacks against a reachable object or structure, applying its defenses and damage rules.
Utilize: a Wisdom (Medicine) check against the fencer's Cultivation Save DC ends a choking creature's Bleed Air.
Utilize: wipe away the blood or dust of a Face Strike from yourself or a creature within 5 feet; its Blinded ends.

effects.evidence: Attack one 5-foot section of a solid wall with Jian (Straight Sword) (its AC and hit points are its text's).

choices.name: Opportunity Attack
choices.when: when an enemy leaves your reach
